property_summary: For any caller and any hash, after lockInGuess the guess's target block must be block.number+1, so settle at block.number+1 must revert (the target block has not passed); the mutant stores block.number instead, so settle at block.number+1 no longer reverts, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Change the stored target block to the current block number, so the guess is recorded for a different block than the original.
